title: Read the Room, Read the Image: Understanding Indirect Speech Acts in Multimodal Visual Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2608.30270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indirect speech acts (ISAs) require pragmatic reasoning over context, as directive intent can- not be inferred from surface form alone. Prior text-based studies and existing multimodal benchmarks largely overlook this requirement, focusing instead on explicitly encoded context or perceptual recognition, and thus underex- plore context-dependent pragmatic understand- ing, particularly in high-context languages such as Korean. We introduce READI, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating ISA understanding through integrated reasoning over visual con- text and dialogue. READI models graded in- directness grounded in pragmatic theory and formulates the task as vision-based pragmatic question answering (V-PQA), supporting cross- lingual evaluation in English and Korean. translated_title: 察言观色，读懂图像：理解多模态视觉语境中的间接言语行为
translated_abstract: 间接言语行为（ISA）需要基于语境进行语用推理，因为指令性意图无法仅从表面形式推断出来。以往基于文本的研究和现有的多模态基准在很大程度上忽视了这一要求，而是专注于显式编码的语境或感知识别，因此未能充分探索依赖语境的语用理解，尤其是在韩语等高语境语言中。我们提出了READI，这是一个多模态基准，用于通过对视觉语境和对话的整合推理来评估间接言语行为理解。READI基于语用理论对分级间接性进行建模，并将该任务表述为基于视觉的语用问答（V-PQA），支持英语和韩语的跨语言评估。实验表明，即使是最先进的多模态模型也难以处理基于视觉的间接言语行为，其性能随着间接性的增加而下降。
tldr: 该论文提出了READI多模态基准，通过视觉语境与对话的整合推理来评估模型对间接言语行为的语用理解能力，实验发现即使最先进的多模态模型也难以应对，且性能随间接性增加而下降。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces READI, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating indirect speech act understanding through integrated reasoning over visual context and dialogue, showing that even state-of-the-art multimodal models struggle, with performance declining as indirectness increases.
